title: The Gasolini AR1: A Low-Cost, Efficient Sports Car as an Alternative to Hypercars
summary: The Gasolini AR1 is a hand-built, lightweight sports car designed by Robert Ely as a sustainable and affordable alternative to high-performance hypercars and expensive sports cars. Utilizing parts from a 2017 Honda CBR500 motorbike, including its 47 hp engine, the AR1 weighs under 1,000 lbs and emphasizes driving enjoyment over speed. The car features a unique aerodynamic design, a tube chassis, and skinny tires from a Ford Ka. Ely also plans an electric version, the AR2, using a HyPer 9 motor and Jaguar I-Pace batteries. The AR1 can be built for under $7,000, with plans and build instructions available for purchase.
